text: Meanwhile, in 660 BC, the islands were home to hunters and fishermen, and rice farming had only just reached the southwest.
spoken: Meanwhile, in six hundred and sixty B.C., the islands were home to hunters and fishermen, and rice farming had only just reached the southwest.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po nazwie, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
